audit_items.proof_trace: Fork digest correctly incorporates blob parameters via hash([blob_entry.epoch, blob_entry.max_blobs_per_block]) XOR fork_data_root(version, genesis_root). The blob_entry.epoch identifies when the blob parameter configuration became active, not the current epoch, which keeps fork_digest stable within parameter eras. All nodes deterministically compute the same digest using the same Config and fallback logic (lines 1047-1049), preventing network partition.
